'''''Han Solo and the Pirates of Kessel''''' was a holothriller that involved [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] battling [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. This holothriller was one of many to feature Han Solo. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] thought that it was almost funny.
